title: A smile that answers someone, around 2 months
summary: CDC says most babies answer talk, or a smile, with a smile of their own by about 2 months.
body: Someone speaks, or offers a smile, and the baby smiles back. That exchange is the 2-month social item on the CDC sheet. The sheet counts an item when at least three quarters of children do it, and it says the leaflet is not a validated screen. A baby without this reply yet is not called ill here. The ages are the United States list.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports the social/emotional milestone 'Smiles when you talk to or smile at her', the 75 percent definition, and the screening-tool sentence.
